definitions.explanation: Lists two or more things as examples, usually in the pattern A やら B やら, with a sense that there were many of them and that the situation was busy, troublesome or mixed. It attaches to nouns and to plain verb and adjective forms.

After a question word, makes it indefinite: {誰|だれ}やら (someone or other), {何|なに}やら (something). After a clause, often as のやら, it expresses that the speaker cannot tell: いつ{終|お}わるのやら (who knows when it will end).

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}やら⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧やら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}らかっている→散らかる：04357_chirakaru⟧。
examples.english: Books, notebooks and whatnot are scattered about.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧やら⟦{恥|は}ずかしい→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧やらで、⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: What with being happy and embarrassed at once, I went red.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧やら⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧やらで、⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: What with getting ready for the move and work and all, last month was really busy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧やら⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧ようだ。
examples.english: It seems someone or other has come.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧やら。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、いったい⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧になったら{終|お}わる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧やら。
examples.english: I wonder when on earth this construction work will ever be finished.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun]やら [noun]やら: A, B and so on (a busy jumble)
- [adjective]やら [adjective]やら: feeling A and B at once (⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧やら⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧やら)
- [question word]やら: some… or other (⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧やら, ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧やら, ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧やら)
- [clause]⟦の→の：09472_no⟧やら: I wonder…; who knows…

SIMILAR WORDS:
- や: and (listing examples) — neutral, used only between nouns; やら adds a sense of a chaotic or burdensome mix
- ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: and, or (listing examples) — colloquial and neutral; works like やら but without the sense of a jumble
- ⟦たり→たり：33215_tari⟧: listing actions (〜⟦たり→たり：33215_tari⟧〜⟦たり→たり：33215_tari⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧)
